newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude mixed in late U.S. paper dealings.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude mixed in late U.S. paper dealings.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil was mixed in late U.S. paper dealings on Wednesday, traders said.
A string of partial July cargoes switched hands at between $19.51 and $19.57 a barrel for a total of 1,300 lots.
The July contract on London's IPE settled at $19.55 a barrel.
June/July traded twice at plus six and plus seven cents a barrel, with talk ending around plus five to eight cents a barrel.
July/August was talked at plus one at four cents, while August/September was thin at flat to plus two cents.
